apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Your devices, in sync (as Spotify Connect): every Tuna you have open on your account (phone, computer, browser) sees what the others are playing. - While music plays on another one, a bar shows where and what, with pause and Play here. - The button by the sound quality in Now Playing lists your devices: pick one and the music moves there, carrying on where it was. Starting music on one pauses the others.
- Autoplay: when an album, a playlist or a radio is about to end, songs like the last few carry on, with a new song of the week now and then. On by default; each device can turn it off in Settings → Listening.

Changed
- Fresh catch is the week's new songs only (30 a week for each person by default; an admin can change it). What's in the library but not played yet has its own mix, Not played yet.
- Song radio is mostly new songs: it asks for songs like the one it started from as it plays, keeping six ready ahead, with songs from the library in between until they're here.
- Radios are 50 songs, as Spotify's (Autoplay carries on after).
- Fresh catch's page is called Fresh catch (it said "Mix").

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
